header: scripts/lib/paced.ts: the plant's RailRadar key, used ONE REQUEST AT A TIME, never closer than `gapMs` (2.2 s = 27 a minute; the key's limit is 30). A refusal for going over the minute's limit (429) is waited out (65 s) and tried again, up to three times; only then is it handed back. `count()` is the number of requests made (a refused one counts too, because RailRadar counts every request). The scripts that collect fares use this.
